facts: Two original UTF-8 create_blob failures and their exact content-address read failures are preserved in the journals.

The initial journal helper prematurely set create_error_reconciled_by_exact_content_address=true whenever create.isError was true; the subsequent 404 still made the helper throw. No artifact from either failed attempt was accepted.
The helper was corrected so reconciliation requires an actually successful exact-byte read. The original erroneous auxiliary flag remains visible in the historical journal.
The Mac 4429-byte source review was later created using the supported base64 encoding with the same bytes and expected Git blob 68f387a48322055bf65d919118d03557189dee2a, then read back in full.

The 1307-byte SDK11 auxiliary provenance note expected at 8add9c136ea6444af174f1468ef7a4c64d13b83b was not available in the observed failed attempts; no successful creation or reconstructed original note is claimed.
Earlier old-helper errors retained only the helper exception, not the underlying original Git SDK response. Those responses are unavailable and are not invented.
No automatic approval-review rejection occurred in these errors; these were Git transport or server errors.
